name: tiger-skills
description: Harness engineering (outer loop) + Code quality (inner loop): a lean, linear single-feature pipeline — grill the spec, architect plans where the code goes, generator builds in a git worktree (branched from dev), reviewer + security, an executor that owns the integration E2E, then a fast-forward merge to dev (main stays protected) and a cartographer keeping CODEBASE_MAP.md current. 6 agents, 15 skills, a deterministic git-committed Workflow. Skills are independent units; agents are a bundle of skills. Based on walkinglabs learn-tiger-grill course.
